record.title: Indonesia orders emergency-only crossing services at three PNG frontier posts for regional elections
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.scope: Indonesian PLBN Skouw, Sota and Yetetkun services.
record.direction: Inbound and outbound service remit; implementation by direction unobserved.
record.movement: Ordinary cross-border service users under the announced emergency-only schedule.
record.exceptions: Illness, accidents, remains repatriation and other emergencies, 08:00–16:00 WIT.
record.enforcement: Formal instruction issued 26 November for polling day; no independent gate observation retrieved.
record.relationship: Distinct from R4-EA-002 April 2019 Skouw election. Three posts grouped under one instruction, not split into three events.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in the cited reports; no present status inferred.
record.official_rationale: Support regional polling while allowing border-service staff to vote.
record.uncertainty: Announced categorical restriction, not merely shortened hours. Actual enforcement and subsequent ordinary-service resumption unknown; no 28 November reopening inferred.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. Scheduled for polling day only; no operational duration computed.
